note: The bookings import's column and status map — data, not code (rule 4). specs/bookings.md explains it. Headers and status words are matched after normalising: lower-cased, every character outside a-z and 0-9 removed, so 'Client e-mail', 'client_email' and 'CLIENT EMAIL' are one name. A platform's own names are tried first, then the generic ones. 'verified' says whether the names were read from the platform's own documentation or a real export; most were not (specs/bookings.md, 'What is unverified'), which is why the generic fallback is wide and the screen shows which columns were understood. lib/bookings/import-map.test.ts holds this file to its shape.

roles.ref: The appointment's own id or booking reference. The idempotency key when present.
roles.start: Date and time in one column.
roles.date: The appointment's date, when the time is in its own column.
roles.status: What happened to the appointment. Required: without it a kept appointment and a no-show look the same.
roles.staff: The team member, chair or room.
roles.client_id: The booking system's own client id. Preferred client identity: hashed, never stored.
roles.client_email: The client's email. Second choice of identity: hashed, never stored.
roles.client_phone: The client's phone. Third choice of identity: hashed, never stored.
roles.price: What the appointment cost, in the currency the owner names for the batch.
roles.cancelled_at: When a cancellation was made. With it, a cancellation under the late-cancellation notice counts as late.

fresha.label: Fresha
fresha.basis: Fresha publishes no column list. A migration guide (support.heygoldie.com, read 2026-10-22) gives the path, Sales > Appointments > Export > CSV, not the headers. The names below are the ones Fresha's appointments list shows on screen, unconfirmed against a real file.

mindbody.label: Mindbody
mindbody.basis: Mindbody's appointment reports (Schedule at a Glance, Attendance) export CSV (docs.gymdesk.com and support.juvonno.com, read 2026-10-22); neither lists headers. The status words are Mindbody's visit states, including its own Late Cancel.

booksy.label: Booksy
booksy.basis: Booksy has no self-service appointment export; its support sends a CSV on request (support.heygoldie.com, read 2026-10-22). The headers are not published, so the generic names carry most of this.

simplybook.label: SimplyBook.me
simplybook.basis: SimplyBook.me exports bookings to Excel from Reports (Client or Detailed reports; support.juvonno.com, read 2026-10-22). Save as CSV first. Headers unconfirmed.

timely.label: Timely
timely.basis: Timely's Appointment Schedule report downloads as CSV for a date range (support.heygoldie.com, read 2026-10-22). Headers unconfirmed.

generic.label: another booking system
generic.basis: The generic names alone, for any other system or a spreadsheet.

square_api.basis: Square's BookingStatus enum (developer.squareup.com/reference/square/enums/BookingStatus, read 2026-10-22). Square has no completed status: an ACCEPTED booking whose start has passed and that the seller did not mark NO_SHOW is the attended one, so 'accepted' counts as completed once it is in the past. A PENDING one in the past was never accepted, and is left out.
